meta.name: Celebrity Bear Hunt
meta.description:
Holly Willoughby hosts this competition show set in the Costa Rican jungle, where 12 celebrities become prey for legendary survival expert, Bear Grylls.

Rated TV-14 · Canceled · First aired 5 Feb 2025 · United Kingdom · Language: English
Studio: Talkback, Workerbee, The Natural Studios · Network: Netflix

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

On your server — Audio: English
meta.slogan: 12 celebrities. 1 bear. Their toughest challenge yet.

videos.title: Let the Hunt Begin
videos.overview: 12 celebrities arrive in the Costa Rican jungle. Their first mission is simply to reach the lodge — without Bear Grylls getting to them first.

videos.title: Let Down by My Bladder
videos.overview: Four people are still in the Bear Pit, and one is not coming back. As they try to dig, climb and race their way to freedom, Bear is not far behind.

videos.title: Sink or Swim
videos.overview: A new challenge sees four celebs thrown in at the deep end. When one finds himself in over his head, his teammate fights to finish the task on his own.

videos.title: Where Did Being Nice Get Me?
videos.overview: As the second celebrity is eliminated, the pressure — and tension — is rising within the camp. Some find themselves wobbling over the next challenge.

videos.title: Between a Croc and a Bear
videos.overview: A test of teamwork sees half of the camp left out in the cold, and one celeb hot under the collar. Not even an al fresco meal manages to calm him down.

videos.title: Pain Is Weakness Leaving Your Body
videos.overview: A dizzying new challenge ends in an injury. For the celebrities entering the Bear Pit, the rules have changed — and the stakes are higher than ever.

videos.title: No Smoke Without Fire
videos.overview: Tempers are already flaring between some members of the camp when Bear sets the celebrities a fiery challenge, which heats things up even further.

videos.title: Last Celebrity Standing
videos.overview: 12 celebrities entered the competition. Now, only five remain. As they try to evade capture one final time, who will be crowned Bear Hunt champion?
